svg.text: AMD Deep Learning Primitives Library - github.com/ROCm/rocm-libraries - ROCm GPU DNN + fusion + auto-tuning
L1 - Framework Integration + Workloads (AMD ROCm DNN primitives - sibling to rocBLAS at application layer)
L2 - Triple API Model (legacy imperative - Fusion API vertical fusions - Graph/Backend API cuDNN-aligned)
Find API or Immediate mode launch
miopenHandle_t per context on HIP backend
Solver search over large config space
FindDb caches benchmark results per user
L3 - API Surface (primitives - fusion operators - backend graph descriptors)
Conv Fwd Bias Activation BN inference
Vertical fusion only - reports unsupported combos
Conv MatMul Pointwise Norm Reduction ops
L4 - Solver / Solution Framework (ProblemConfig - applicable solvers - compile - benchmark - invoker)
JIT compile HIP/OpenCL kernel if miss
Run applicable solvers on target GPU
Pick fastest - write User FindDb entry
L5 - Kernel Backends + Databases (Composable Kernel - rocMLIR - FindDb - PerfDb - precompiled)
CK templated GEMM conv reduction tiles
System: popular configs at install path
Popular shapes shipped as binary blobs
L6 - Source Layout (ROCm/rocm-libraries - src/solver/ - src/kernels/ - HIP backend - driver tool)
Fusion API Execution Path (Conv + Bias + ReLU vertical fusion)
Single fused kernel - reduce HBM round-trips and kernel launch overhead
Step 1: miopenCreateFusionPlan - set vertical fusion axis - miopenCreateOpConv/etc
Step 2: Add operators in order: ConvFwd - Bias - Activation - optional BN inference
Step 3: miopenCompileFusionPlan - JIT fused kernel into MIOpen kernel cache
Step 4: miopenSetFusionArgs - bind weights bias activ params per operator
Step 5: miopenExecuteFusionPlan on HIP stream - one kernel for full subgraph
Unsupported combos reported at compile time - FP32 FP16 BFP16 fusion tables per GPU arch
Find path: miopenFindConvolutionForwardAlgorithm - benchmark solvers - cache to User FindDb
Immediate: miopenConvolutionForwardImmediate - FindDb hit or AI heuristic - skip full find
AMD ROCm reference DNN library - auto-tuning + fusion + multi-algorithm conv solvers
CreateFusionPlan - add ops - CompileFusionPlan - SetFusionArgs - ExecuteFusionPlan
Design Position (AMD ROCm DNN layer - solver auto-tuning + FindDb + fusion for peak conv perf on MI GPUs)
Multi-algorithm solvers + Composable Kernel + FindDb immediate mode = default DNN backend for PyTorch on ROCm
Init: miopenCreate - load System FindDb - HIP device context - optional precompiled kernel package
Loop: find or immediate - solver compile - invoker execute - fusion compile - graph backend execute
